summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Transportation & Logistics Systems, Inc. under Items 1.01 and 9.01, disclosing entry into a material definitive agreement with related financial statements and exhibits. The excerpt contains only cover-page and forward-looking-statement boilerplate; it identifies no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist stake, spin-off, restructuring or other special-situation event, and no substantive agreement terms are described. No board recommendation, advisor, price, stake, premium or closing date is stated. With no special-situation trigger and no deal economics, there is no arbitrage angle; watch for the undisclosed underlying agreement.
